question: Can the unchanged coherent-cycle carrier use the highest-new-visible-surface partial views from consumed OA2 while still rejecting fixed cross-scene exact-target-absent controls?

selection.reference_rule: First greedy portfolio view: maximum depth-consistent target vertices under quarter-inside and anti-sliver admission.
selection.query_rule: First greedy portfolio view: maximum depth-consistent target vertices under quarter-inside and anti-sliver admission.

evaluation.negative_authority: Both control queries come from a different physical scan family and cannot contain exact target MV05.

forbidden_after_freeze: change OA2, target 5, reference frame 102, query frame 64 or either fixed control
use portfolio second views, query truth, RGB or model output to alter the selected pair
change coherent-cycle models, masks, thresholds, affine extent gate or selective cascade threshold
claim a consumed-source posthoc result is fresh confirmation
claim_boundary: This freezes one consumed-source, geometry/depth-selected, RGB/model-fresh partial-view Development carrier test with two new exact-target-absent pairings. A pass can show only that the unchanged coherent-cycle carrier uses this observed partial-view pair; it is not confirmation, provider independence, raw-camera binding, named entrance, ownership, access, traversability, waypoint, arrival, handoff, deployment, benefit, reliability or safety.
